manifest.name: @local/dsh-chat-privacy-blur
manifest.description: Blurs the questions and answers in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation until the pointer rests on them.
manifest.author: outmanwt

readme.section: DSH Chat Privacy Blur · 对话隐私遮罩
readme.text:
[](https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

A display-layer privacy guard for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: every question and every answer in the conversation is drawn blurred, and only the row under the pointer shows its original text. Made for an open-plan office, a shared screen, or a screen recording.

DSH Web 对话的显示层隐私遮挡：提问与回答一律画成模糊，鼠标停在哪一条，才显示那一条的原文。给工位旁边有人、共享屏幕、或者正在录屏的时候用。

- Blurs the question and answer rows by default; hovering (or keyboard focus) reveals that one row and re-blurs it when the pointer leaves.
- 默认全部模糊，鼠标停在哪一条显示哪一条；键盘 Tab 聚焦进某条同样显示，移开立即恢复模糊。
- Leaving the window (Alt+Tab, another app, a hidden tab) withdraws the reveal at once: the mask becomes `Always blurred` until the window is focused again, so a row you left the pointer on is never readable behind your back.
- 离开窗口（Alt+Tab、切到别的应用、标签页被隐藏）立刻收回显示：遮罩临时变成「始终模糊」，回到窗口才恢复你选的模式——指针停在某条上也不会留在那里露着。
- One control below the composer cycles three modes — `Off` / `Hover to reveal` / `Always blurred` — and the choice is remembered per browser.
- 输入框下方一个按钮循环切换三档：`关闭` / `悬停显示` / `始终模糊`，选择按浏览器记住，换会话、重开窗口都保持。
- Only drawn pixels change: message text, copy actions, `/` commands and the model input keep their original characters, and the stylesheet is added and removed with the control.
- 只改画出来的像素：正文、复制、模型输入都保持原样；样式表跟着控件挂载与卸载，不留全局残留。
- Follows the host theme (`--dsw-alias-*` tokens), light and dark, and both interface languages.
- 跟随宿主主题令牌与界面语言，浅色/深色都对。

| Mode / 模式 | Behaviour / 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 关闭 · Off | Nothing is masked; identical to a host without the plugin. |
| 悬停显示 · Hover to reveal (default) | All rows blurred; the hovered or focused row shows its text, withheld while the window is unfocused. |
| 始终模糊 · Always blurred | All rows stay blurred, even under the pointer. |

The mode is stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-chat-privacy-blur:mode`. Clearing it falls back to `hover`.
模式存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-chat-privacy-blur:mode`，删掉就回到默认的「悬停显示」。

A hover or keyboard reveal is a pointer/focus state, and that state outlives the window losing focus: the row you left the cursor on — or one whose copy button still holds focus — would stay readable while you look at something else. So while the window is unfocused or the page is hidden, the mask is drawn as `Always blurred`, the control reports the lock in its tooltip, and the chosen mode returns with the focus. `Off` stays off: a mask you turned off is never forced back on.
悬停和键盘聚焦都是「指针/焦点状态」，而这两种状态在窗口失去焦点后依然成立：你指针停留的那条、或某个刚被点过的按钮所在的那条，会一直露着。所以窗口失焦或页面被隐藏时，遮罩改画成「始终模糊」，控件在提示里说明已上锁，回到窗口再恢复你选的模式。`关闭` 就是关闭：被关掉的遮罩不会被强行打开。

readme.section: What is blurred / 模糊范围
readme.text:
Masked rows are selected by the conversation row attributes the host already publishes for its own layout:

| Row attribute / 行属性 | Content / 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `data-chat-flow-kind="user"` | your question / 你发的问题 |
| `data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"` | the assistant reply, including the compacted answer row / 助手回答，含折叠成小卡的最终回答 |
| `data-chat-flow-kind="steering"` | input injected mid-turn / 回合进行中插入的补充输入 |

readme.section: What is blurred / 模糊范围
readme.text:
Not masked: tool-call cards, the reasoning wrapper, the sidebar session list, the composer, `/goal` bar and the turn previews.
不遮挡：工具调用卡片、思考过程外层、侧边栏会话列表、输入框、`/goal` 输入条与轮次预览。

If a future host renames those row attributes, nothing gets blurred — the plugin degrades to doing nothing rather than breaking the page.
如果宿主以后改了这些行属性名，插件会退化成"什么都不糊"，不会弄坏页面。

In DSH, ask your agent / 在 DSH 中对 AI 说：

> 安装插件 https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur/releases/latest/download/dsh-chat-privacy-blur.tgz

Or use the plugin-manager tool with these arguments / 也可调用插件管理工具，参数：

```json
{
  "action": "install_bundle",
  "target": "https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur/releases/latest/download/dsh-chat-privacy-blur.tgz"
}

For CLI-managed profiles / 对于自行管理的 CLI profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur/releases/latest/download/dsh-chat-privacy-blur.tgz
```

Desktop users should install through their running app's plugin manager, not an unrelated `web` profile. Follow the installation result for refresh/restart instructions.
桌面版请通过正在使用的应用安装到当前 profile；不要另建 `web` profile。安装后按宿主提示刷新或重启，输入框下方才会出现「悬停显示 / 关闭 / 始终模糊」按钮。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur.git
cd dsh-chat-privacy-blur
npm test
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts

Install the absolute directory through `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`. There is no build step: the checked-in client file is the browser artifact.
用绝对路径通过 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 安装本地目录。没有构建步骤：仓库里的 client 文件就是浏览器产物。

The radius defaults to `6px` and reads the `--dsh-chat-blur` custom property, so a theme layer can change it without touching the plugin:

```css
:root { --dsh-chat-blur: 10px; }
```

Developed against DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` (desktop, Web GUI). Uses the client module loader, one `conversation.composer.dock` entry, the `locale` dictionary registry, and the host's own conversation row attributes. Older or newer hosts are unverified; the mask is a stylesheet only, so a host change costs the blur, not the page.
在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.4`（桌面版 Web GUI）上开发。依赖客户端模块加载器、`conversation.composer.dock` 一个槽位、`locale` 词条注册，以及宿主自己的对话行属性。其他版本未验证；遮罩只是样式表，宿主改版最坏情况是"不再模糊"，不会影响页面。

No network requests, no analytics, no credential access, no host state. The mode lives in the page's `localStorage`; the plugin reads nothing from the session. Masking is visual: text stays in the DOM and can still be selected, copied, or read by assistive technology, so it is not an access control.
不联网、不埋点、不碰凭据、不写宿主状态；模式只存在页面 `localStorage`，插件不读取会话内容。遮挡只是视觉层：文字仍在 DOM 里，仍可选中、复制、被辅助技术读到，所以它不是访问控制。

`npm test` runs [scripts/check.mjs](scripts/check.mjs): manifest and patch, exported display resources, client syntax, then the real `client.js` loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__` with the mode control mounted in a small re-rendering hook runtime — slot registration, dictionary parity, the exact mask stylesheet of all three modes, the click cycle and its persistence, and the focus lock driven through real `blur`, `focus` and `visibilitychange` events. Painted pixels are checked by eye on the running page, not by the gate.
`npm test` 跑 [scripts/check.mjs](scripts/check.mjs)：清单与 patch、导出资源、语法，然后用 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 真实加载 `client.js`，把模式控件挂在一个会重渲染的小 hooks 运行时里，检查槽位注册、词条对齐、三档模式的样式表内容、点击循环与持久化，以及通过真实 `blur` / `focus` / `visibilitychange` 事件驱动的失焦上锁。画出来的像素靠人眼在页面上看，不靠这个门禁。

See [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md). Tags matching the package version trigger GitHub Actions to check the bundle and attach a fixed-name `dsh-chat-privacy-blur.tgz` plus SHA-256 checksums to a GitHub Release. The package is distributed through GitHub; it is **not published to npm**.

The `@local/dsh-chat-privacy-blur` name is retained to preserve the installed identifier. It is a package identifier, not a claim of npm availability.

The market application reads the [Awesome DSH Plugin catalog](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin). Listing requires a separate catalog PR and maintainer acceptance; a public repository alone does not make the plugin searchable there. See [marketplace/outmanwt__dsh-chat-privacy-blur.yml](marketplace/outmanwt__dsh-chat-privacy-blur.yml) for the proposed entry.

Uses the DSH/Cordis extension APIs. The masked row attributes are the ones the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness built-in chat and conversation UI packages publish for their own layout. See [NOTICE](NOTICE).
